regionOffline.subject_one: Region {region} is offline: {count} of your checks is not running
regionOffline.subject_other: Region {region} is offline: {count} of your checks are not running
regionOffline.preheader: Since {since}, checks that run only from {region} are not being checked.
regionOffline.heading: Region {region} is offline
regionOffline.since: The SolidPing region {region} has been offline since {since}.
regionOffline.blind_one: {count} of your checks in {org} runs only from this region, so it is not being checked right now:
regionOffline.blind_other: {count} of your checks in {org} run only from this region, so they are not being checked right now:
regionOffline.reduced_one: {count} other check keeps running from its other regions.
regionOffline.reduced_other: {count} other checks keep running from their other regions.
regionOffline.nothingToDo: There is nothing to do on your side. The SolidPing team has been alerted, and you will get a second email when the region is back. Until then these checks will show no data rather than a status.
regionOffline.nothingToDoOneCheck: There is nothing to do on your side. The SolidPing team has been alerted, and you will get a second email when the region is back. Until then this check will show no data rather than a status.

regionRecovered.moved: The checks of {org} that ran only from {region} no longer depend on it and are being checked again.
regionRecovered.back: The SolidPing region {region} is back online, and the checks of {org} that ran only from it resumed.

usageCap.otherChannels: Other channels (email, Slack, push...) keep working.

customDomain.subject: Your status page stopped serving on {domain}
customDomain.preheader: DNS re-verification kept failing, so {domain} no longer serves your status page.
customDomain.heading: {domain} is no longer serving your status page
customDomain.stopped: The custom domain {domain} on the status page {page} ({org}) failed its DNS re-verification for several days in a row, so SolidPing has stopped serving the page on it. Visitors now get an error page instead of your status page.
customDomain.fix: To fix it: confirm the domain's CNAME record still points at the target shown on the status page's settings, then click {verify}. If DNS starts resolving correctly again on its own, SolidPing will also restore the domain by itself after several consecutive successful checks.
